pages.rationale: Every prior P0/P1 on this page is fixed and verified: the failed badge now lands on 04 Encode, frame 0b has its own header/toolbar/hand-off/footer chip and badges 03 Encode stale, the inline rename cancels on Escape and commits on Enter, Send to Review's confirm is disabled with a per-field reason for 0/99999/abc/empty so the 20,000 cap holds, bypass now repaints the row (badge paused, its own caption), a deleted stage renumbers everywhere including the block-page ribbon and the invalid Model row carries 'Put the stage back' / 'Open 05 and rebind its input' with both hand-off buttons disabled and a reason, and the 0b Model caption now cites 02 Cluster and the B7 split. All three popovers open by button, by deep link, and close on Escape and on an outside click; both modals likewise; running cancels; failed clears; every row icon either navigates or toasts 'not wired yet: ...'. No console errors in any state. Deducted one point for the inline rename's outside-click, which neither commits nor cancels.

pages.rationale: All ten prior findings are fixed and verified in the browser. The split strip now carries in-band labels ('train | 185 windows' ...), a red drop mark row captioned 'red where a break drops them (19)' and a window tick strip; the boundary close-up has a pale amber 'gap 10 min' band with the caption below the plot; the checks card follows the live settings (it reads 'gap 2 min < window 10 min' when the gap is invalid and 'windows DO cross split boundaries' on a random split); ?state=edited deep-links the frame's pending change (gap 5 -> 10, '1 unapplied change'); the bar names every field that changed and counts them ('2 unapplied changes | split ... | blocks ...'); split ratio and block count move the bands, the per-band counts and the verdict totals; the gap field validates -5, abc and empty and disables both primaries with a full reason; toolbar and bar now offer the same primary; after a completed run the primary is disabled with 'no unapplied changes'; Save window set opens with a valid default that saves (library save-window-set write) and disables on 'Bad Id'. An edit survives navigating to another block and back. No console errors. Deducted one point for the band labels dropping out on a narrow band.

pages.rationale: All three prior P1s are fixed: the unapplied bar now names the change that was actually made ('CNN scores included', 'clip +/- 3 sigma -> +/- 2 sigma', 'normalise z-score per channel -> per window') and counts them; clip moves both the legend (-2 sigma / +2 sigma) and the heat cell fills; a column click resolves a real window (34 / 199 / 393 at 2.8 / 16.5 / 32.7 h) and 'Open in Encode' lands on block/4?window=393 where the class and hour agree. The rest of the page drives well: group ticks raise the P12 leakage callout with the drop action, both modals open by deep link and close on Escape, Create SLURM script writes a jobs add-job, Upload matrix toasts 'not wired yet', a real Apply & re-run walks 01 -> 03 to done. Deducted for the toolbar primary that offers an apply with nothing pending, and two copy defects.

This is the two-disagreeing-primaries defect that was fixed on 01 windows but is still here on 02.

findings.detail: upload-path takes '', '   ' or '!!!nonsense' and 'Place matrix' stays enabled with no disabled reason, while the checks above it keep reading 'recipe hash matches a7f3...9c' and '543 columns'. Confirming toasts 'not wired yet: bind an uploaded matrix artifact', so nothing is misrecorded, but the field is unvalidated where every sibling field on these pages is validated.

pages.rationale: The three prior function P1s are fixed: the criterion cards now carry aria-checked plus a 'chosen' badge; locking really locks (the Parameters criterion dropdown is disabled, the choose-k cards show a per-card reason 'the criterion is locked - unlock it in Parameters to change it' and are not clickable, and the Unlock the toast points at exists and re-enables the dropdown); Save grouping records the scope you picked ({scope:'this section only'}) and the 'covers' line follows it. The cutline is draggable and moves the cut height and k live; merge is pending-then-apply with its own bar sentence; resample and show distinguishing features toast 'not wired yet'; send-review and the run veil work. Deducted because changing k never reaches the three panels that are about k.

findings.detail: With locked=1 the Parameters criterion button is disabled, criterion-warning reads 'criterion locked - fixed-k - k is a consequence of it' with an Unlock beside it, and the choose-k cards refuse a real click (cursor not-allowed, per-card reason).

findings.title: Changing the cut never reaches the class cards, occupancy strip or per-class bars
findings.detail: Drag the cutline down: Parameters updates to 'cut height 7.7 / k 12' and the bar offers 'cut 7.7 -> 12 classes'. Click Apply & re-run from 03 and let the veil finish. Parameters still says k 12, but 'What each class looks like' still shows exactly six cards C1 260 / C2 180 / C3 51 / C4 32 / C5 13 / C6 7, the occupancy strip still six lanes, the 'Windows per class' bars still six bars, and the button under them still reads 'Merge C5 + C6'. The frame's whole point is that the cut decides the classes; here only the dendrogram and the two numbers move.

findings.title: silhouette and cophenetic r are frozen for every cut
findings.detail: Cut 4.0 (k 18), 7.7 (k 12) and 10.1 (k 6) all report 'silhouette 0.24 - cophenetic r 0.91'. Silhouette is a function of the partition, so it cannot be constant across k, and this is the number the 'max silhouette' criterion on the same page selects on.

findings.detail: ?merge=C5,C6 sets the bar to 'C5 + C6 merged - 04 and 05 re-run on 5 classes' but the class cards and per-class bars still list C5 13 and C6 7 separately, with nothing marking them as about to merge.

pages.rationale: Two of the three prior P1s are fully fixed and the third is fixed in effect: image size now moves the disk and time tiles (224 -> 0.6 GB / ~6 min, 256 -> 0.8 GB / ~8 min, 128 -> 0.2 GB / ~2 min) and PAA 2x halves them; the window chip reads a real class, split and hour from the shared helper, the pager and a typed window id move it (300 -> C3 24.9 h, 500 -> C1 test block 41.6 h) with >= 1 / <= 543 / not a number / required all validated; browse class cards land on a window of that class (C4 -> 83 C4, C2 -> 1 C2, C6 -> 438 C6) and the three browse tabs switch the caption and the route. Resample toasts a seeded note, the encoder-version note and the run veil are there, no console errors. Deducted for the unapplied bar, which still will not name the parameter you changed, and a degenerate estimate.

pages.rationale: All three prior P1s are fixed. Architecture and epochs now re-cost and re-caption the 05 row and the trial estimate (B0/30 -> 2 h 40 and ~2 h 46; B2/30 -> 4 h 19 and ~4 h 25; B2/60 -> 8 h 38 and ~8 h 44); stage ticks change both the --from-stage and the cost (ticking 02 adds 14 min, 03 adds 40 s, 01 adds nothing because it is < 1 s); with nothing ticked Copy script, Download trial job and both Train in Models buttons are disabled with 'no stage is ticked - tick at least one for the job to do something'. The rest drives cleanly: the three label-source cards each swap in their own note with a working Send to Review / Train in Models, Download trial job writes a jobs add-job and shows the chip, Train in Models writes models add-training-job and routes to #/models/launch?template=cnn_windows_v3 (P11), both modals validate and close on Escape, and the before-this-trains callouts link to 03's merge and to Review. Deducted for the uncaught clipboard rejection and two small inconsistencies in the 04-unticked state.

findings.detail: param-architecture EfficientNet-B2 with 60 epochs gives '05 Train model | 8 h 38 | EfficientNet-B2 - 60 - early stop' and the trial estimate '~ 8 h 44'.

findings.title: prev fixed: stage ticks change the cost
findings.detail: Ticking 02 moves the estimate 8 h 44 -> 8 h 58 and 03 -> 8 h 59, and the script's stage range follows ('stages 01 -> 05').

findings.title: prev fixed: the three job buttons disable with a reason
findings.detail: copy-script, download-trial, train-in-models and train-in-models-top all carry data-disabled-reason 'no stage is ticked - tick at least one for the job to do something'.

findings.title: Copy script raises an uncaught clipboard rejection
findings.detail: Clicking Copy script emits a pageerror: "Failed to execute 'writeText' on 'Clipboard': Write permission denied." The toast still appears, so the failure is silent to the researcher but loud in the console. Triggered here by a headless context without clipboard permission - it is the unhandled rejection, not the denial, that is the defect.

findings.title: Unticking 04 disables 05 with the wrong reason and keeps 05's cost
findings.detail: Unticking 04 also clears 05 (its row reads 'no images - tick 04 Encode first', its tick is no longer clickable) and every job button then says 'no stage is ticked'. The documented reason for this state is '04 Encode is unticked - 05 would have no images to train on'; and the 05 row still charges '2 h 40 | cluster - GPU' for a stage that will not run.
